answer: Make every agent solve a small proof-of-work puzzle tied to its public key before its first transaction each epoch. A few seconds of compute is nothing for one honest agent, but a sybil farm spawning ten thousand identities faces a rising tide of CPU cost it cannot fake or outsource cheaply. Agents that keep solving build a reputation ledge — a visible, hard-won foothold — while fresh identities start at the bottom with nothing to spend. The ledger becomes an oasis where only agents with proven, continuous work transact cheaply, and each new fake identity must climb all over again.
